borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Construction of a 1x bed, 1 person single storey dwelling with associated external amenity area, bicycle storage and waste storage at land adjacent to 8A Neville Gardens Dagenham RM8 3QT
decision_conditions: The proposed development would cause a loss of local amenity including to neighbouring occupiers, would not be located in an area with a high level of access to public transport and would lack any direct street frontage. It is not an appropriate appropriate form or type of development within the existing external amenity context, would be within a land-locked site and would not provide safe and secure access to the residential units. As such, the proposal is considered contrary to the following policies: - National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024)- Policies D6, D14 and T4 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies SP3, SP8, DMD1, DMT1, DMH5 and DMSI3 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)

The submission fails to demonstrate that the proposal would not result in a harmful impact and increased stress on parking within the surrounding streets. As such, the proposal is contrary to the following policies:- Policies T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies SP8, and DMT 2 of  the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)
The proposal fails to demonstrate compliance with the Biodiversity Net Gain Requirements and is contrary to Schedule 7A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

The proposed development,  by reason of siting, scale, design and appearance, would be a prominent addition to an area typically reserved for rear amenity space of the existing terrace dwellings that would disrupt the established pattern of development within the area. It would thereby cause harm to the surrounding character and appearance, including to the street scene, and would cause harm to the significance of the non-designated heritage asset and its special historic character in this location of the Becontree Estate. As such, the proposed development would be contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development proposals respect the existing character and appearance and preserve or enhance historic distinctiveness:- National Planning Policy Framework (MHCLG, December 2024)- Policies D1, D4, and HC1 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies SP2, SPP6, DMD1, and DMD4 of the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)
